Select the ridge regularization parameter using cross-validation

Source: R/ridge_cv.R
ridge_cv.Rd

Selects the regularization parameter using k-fold cross-validation performed by the C++ implementation.

Usage

ridge_cv(x, y, lambda_grid, k = 5, seed = 123)

Arguments

x

A numeric matrix of predictors.

y

A numeric vector of responses.

lambda_grid

A numeric vector of strictly positive regularization parameters to evaluate.

k

Number of folds for cross-validation.

seed

Random seed for reproducibility.

Value

An object of class "ridge_cv" containing the selected lambda, cross-validation errors, fold-specific errors, coefficients, and fold assignments.

Examples

x <- matrix(rnorm(80), ncol = 2)
y <- 2 + 3 * x[, 1] - x[, 2] + rnorm(40)
result <- ridge_cv(x, y, 10^seq(-3, 2, length.out = 10))
result$best_lambda
#> [1] 0.001
